title: LatchGatewayCapabilitiesV2
description: Canonical discovery document for the Latch protocol-major-2 gateway. No v1 discovery route exists.

preview.description: One-shot pane capture at the observe grant. Absent on a gateway that predates the preview route, which a client must read as unavailable rather than as false-by-default.

browseDirectories.description: Browse canonical host directories at the control grant. Absence means unavailable.

createSession.description: Create a standard host shell at the control grant. Absence means unavailable.

stopSession.description: Stop one running session at the control grant. Absence means unavailable.

attachments.description: Upload one file into the session's working directory at the interact grant, so a message can reference it by path. Absence means unavailable.

agentModels.description: List the models a hosted agent can start with, at the control grant (GET /v2/agents/{agent}/models), and accept `model` on session creation. Absence means unavailable: create agents without choosing a model.

notificationKey.description: Register the X25519 public key this device's attention notifications are sealed to (PUT /v2/notifications/key) at the observe grant. Absence means alerts stay generic.

gitRepositories.description: List repositories from running sessions and the host's recent list (GET /v2/git/repositories) at the control grant. Absence means the gateway has no Git routes.

gitResolve.description: Resolve a folder to its working tree root (GET /v2/git/resolve) at the control grant.

gitStatus.description: Read one working tree's status (GET /v2/git/status) at the control grant. Read-only; never fetches.

gitDiff.description: Read one changed file's bounded, paged diff (GET /v2/git/diff) at the control grant.

gitBranches.description: List local branches with their upstreams (GET /v2/git/branches) at the control grant.

gitStage.description: Stage whole files, or every file in one area (POST /v2/git/stage) at the control grant. Returns a durable receipt.

gitUnstage.description: Unstage whole files, or every staged file (POST /v2/git/unstage) at the control grant. Returns a durable receipt.

gitCommit.description: Commit exactly the reviewed index with the host's Git identity and hooks (POST /v2/git/commit) at the control grant. Returns a durable receipt.

gitCreateBranch.description: Create a local branch from a reviewed commit, optionally switching to it (POST /v2/git/branches/create) at the control grant. Returns a durable receipt.

gitSwitchBranch.description: Switch to an existing local branch without forcing (POST /v2/git/branches/switch) at the control grant. Returns a durable receipt.

gitReceipts.description: Look up this device's Git mutation receipt by request id (GET /v2/git/receipts/{requestId}) at the control grant.

gitSync.description: Review the current branch's upstream, its remote and the incoming commits as last fetched (GET /v2/git/sync) at the control grant. Read-only; never fetches.

gitFetch.description: Fetch one remote with the host's own credentials, only when the user asks (POST /v2/git/fetch) at the control grant. Returns a durable receipt with progress.

gitFastForward.description: Fast-forward the current branch to the reviewed upstream commit, never merging or rebasing instead (POST /v2/git/fast-forward) at the control grant. Returns a durable receipt.

gitMerge.description: Merge the reviewed upstream commit into the current branch (POST /v2/git/merge) at the control grant. Returns a durable receipt; Git may stop on conflicts.

gitRebase.description: Rebase the current branch onto the reviewed upstream commit (POST /v2/git/rebase) at the control grant. Returns a durable receipt; Git may stop on conflicts.

gitContinue.description: Continue the merge or rebase in progress once no conflicts remain (POST /v2/git/continue) at the control grant. Returns a durable receipt.

gitAbort.description: Abort the merge or rebase in progress after explicit confirmation (POST /v2/git/abort) at the control grant. Returns a durable receipt.

gitStageResolved.description: POST /v2/git/stage accepts conflicted files (marking them resolved) and confirmConflictMarkers. Absent: conflicted files cannot be staged from the phone.

gitPushPreview.description: Review what a push of the current branch would send: remote, push URL, source and destination branches and commits, outgoing commits as last fetched (GET /v2/git/push/preview) at the control grant. Read-only; never contacts the remote.

gitPush.description: Push the reviewed source commit to the reviewed remote branch with a normal, never forced, push using the host's credentials (POST /v2/git/push) at the control grant. Returns a durable receipt with progress.

gitPushReconcile.description: Settle an uncertain push receipt by asking the remote where the destination is, only when the user asks (POST /v2/git/push/reconcile) at the control grant.

sessionAgents.description: Hosted agent kinds the create route accepts in its `agent` field. Absence means the gateway creates standard shells only. Whether the agent is actually installed is answered at creation time, not here.

attachmentMaxBytes.description: Largest file body the attachments route accepts, in bytes. Present exactly when `endpoints.attachments` is true.
